categories.name: Pre-Trip Foundation
categories.description: Research, insurance, documents and the plans to make before you pack.
categories.intro: A safe journey begins long before you pack your bags. These foundations are worth doing for every solo trip.

categories.name: Packing & Preparation
categories.description: What to bring, what to leave behind, and how to carry it.
categories.intro: What you pack, and how you pack it, has a real effect on your safety and convenience. Pack smart, not heavy.

categories.name: Transportation Safety
categories.description: Airports, taxis, layovers and long rides, handled with confidence.
categories.intro: How you get around is a large part of the journey. Move through planes, trains and taxis like someone who has done it before.

categories.name: Accommodation Safety
categories.description: Choose a secure place to stay and make the room your own.
categories.intro: Where you sleep is your sanctuary. Follow these steps to keep your home base secure throughout the trip.

categories.name: Daily Exploration
categories.description: Street sense for new neighborhoods, crowds and transit.
categories.intro: This is where the adventure happens. Staying aware and making good choices on the street is the key to a great day.

categories.name: Money & Valuables
categories.description: Protect cash, cards and belongings with simple habits.
categories.intro: Good financial habits and a little caution keep your valuables safe, so you can focus on the fun.

categories.name: Digital Safety
categories.description: Phones, Wi-Fi, social media and the trail you leave online.
categories.intro: Your digital footprint matters as much as your physical one. Protect your data and your presence online.

categories.name: Food & Drink Safety
categories.description: Enjoy local food and nights out with less risk.
categories.intro: Local food is a highlight of travel. These guidelines help make sure you remember it for the right reasons.

categories.name: Social Safety
categories.description: Meet people, make friends and date on your own terms.
categories.intro: Making friends is one of the best parts of solo travel. Build connections while keeping yourself safe.

categories.name: Emergency Response
categories.description: What to do, in order, when something goes wrong.
categories.intro: Nobody plans for an emergency, but every smart traveler prepares for one. Knowing how to react makes it manageable.

categories.name: The Full Checklist
categories.description: Forty-eight actions for before, during and just in case, with saved progress.
categories.intro: Every critical safety action in one place.
